name: metastasis associated lung adenocarcinoma transcript 1

function.text: MALAT1 produces a nuclear long noncoding RNA implicated in regulation of gene expression and ribonucleoprotein organization; processing of its precursor also generates a small cytoplasmic RNA.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Gastroblastoma; TFEB-altered renal cell carcinoma; GLI1-altered mesenchymal tumor, malignant/metastasizing. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: MALAT1 produces a nuclear long noncoding RNA from a precursor that also yields the small mascRNA product through RNase P cleavage. The mature long RNA lacks a conventional poly(A) tail and is stabilized by a triple-helical structure at its 3' end. It is thought to act as a scaffold for ribonucleoprotein assemblies and participates in regulation of gene expression and the cell cycle.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MALAT1 have been reported in gastroblastoma, TFEB-altered renal cell carcinoma, and GLI1-altered mesenchymal tumor, malignant/metastasizing.
